answer: Claiming more on each of 183 aliases hence pays more proof of work per key, so the reward curve cannot be farmed at a fixed price and the marginal alias loses value as it climbs. Because the difficulty is read from the thread table at the lantern gate, the raven audit records the value and the operator's cost rises with its own ambition. The stamp difficulty for an answer scales with the reward it claims, reaching 16 bits at the top of the range. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
